Alif-Laam-Meem
Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki taraf say yeh aik aesi kitab utaari jarahi hai jiss mein koi shak ki baat nahi hai .

kiya log yeh keh rahey hain kay payghumber ney issay khud gharr liya hai ? nahi ! ( aey payghumber ! ) yeh to woh haq hai jo tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say iss liye aaya hai kay tum iss kay zariye unn logon  ko khabrdar kero jinn kay paas tum say pehlay koi khabrdar kernay wala nahi aaya ,   takay woh sahih raastay per aajayen .

Allah woh hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko aur unn kay darmiyan sari cheezon ko cheh din mein peda kiya , phir uss ney arsh per istawa farmaya .   uss kay siwa naa tumhara koi rakhwala hai , naa koi sirfarishi .   kiya phir bhi tum kissi naseehat per dhiyan nahi detay-?

woh aasman say ley ker zameen tak her kaam ka intizam khud kerta hai , phir woh kaam aik aesay din mein uss kay paas oopper phonch jata hai jiss ki miqdaar tumhari ginti kay hisab say aik hazar saal hoti hai .
woh her chupi aur khuli cheez ka janney wala hai , jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki rehmat bhi kamil .
uss ney jo cheez bhi peda ki , ussay khoob banaya , aur insan ki takhleeq ki ibtida garay say ki .
phir uss ki nasal aik nichoray huye haqeer paani say chalai .
phir ussay theek thaak ker kay uss mein apni rooh phoonki , aur ( insano ! ) tumharay liye kaan , aankhen aur dil peda kiye . tum log shukar thora hi kertay ho .

aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  kiya jab hum zameen mein rull ker kho jayen gay , to kiya uss waqt hum kissi naye janam mein peda hon gay ?  baat darasal yeh hai kay yeh log apney perwerdigar say ja-milney ka inkar kertay hain .
keh do kay :  tumhen moat ka woh farishta poora poora wasool kerlay ga jo tum per muqarrar kiya gaya hai , phir tumhen wapis tumharay perwerdigar kay paas ley jaya jaye ga .

aur kaash tum woh manzar dekho jab yeh mujrim log apney rab kay samney sar jhukaye huye ( kharray ) hon gay , ( keh rahey hon gay kay : )  humaray perwerdigar ! humari aankhen aur humaray kaan khul gaye , iss liye hamen ( duniya mein ) dobara bhej dijiye , takay hum naik amal keren . hamen achi tarah yaqeen aa-chuka hai .

aur agar hum chahtay to her shaks ko ( pehlay hi ) uss ki hidayat dey detay , lekin woh baat jo meri taraf say kahi gaee thi , tey hochuki hai kay :  mein jahannum ko jinnaat aur insanon sabb say zaroor bhar dun ga .

abb ( jahannum ka ) maza chakho kiyonkay tum ney apney iss din ka samna kernay ko bhula daala tha . hum ney ( bhi ) tumhen bhula diya hai . jo kuch tum kertay rahey ho , uss kay badlay abb hamesha kay azab ka maza chakhtay raho .

humari aayaton per to woh log emaan latay hain jinn ka haal yeh hai kay jab unhen inn aayaton kay zariye naseehat ki jati hai to woh sajday mein gir parrtay hain , aur apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh kertay hain , aur woh takabbur nahi kertay .

unn kay pehlo ( raat kay waqt ) apney bistaron say juda hotay hain   woh apney perwerdigar ko darr aur umeed ( kay milay jazbaat ) kay sath pukar rahey hotay hain ,   aur hum ney unn ko jo rizq diya hai , woh uss mein say ( naiki kay kamon mein ) kharch kertay hain .
chunacheh kissi mutanaffas ko kuch pata nahi hai kay aesay logon  kay liye aankhon ki thandak ka kiya saman unn kay aemal kay badlay mein chupa ker rakha gaya hai .
bhala batao kay jo shaks momin ho , kiya woh uss shaks kay barabar hojaye jo fasiq hai-? ( zahir hai kay ) woh barabar nahi hosaktay .

chunacheh jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn kay liye mustaqil qayam kay baaghaat hain jo unn ko pehli mehmani hi kay tor per dey diye jayen gay , unn aemal kay silay mein jo woh kiya kertay thay .

rahey woh log jinhon ney nafarmani ki hai , to unn kay mustaqil qayam ki jagah jahannum hai . jab bhi woh uss say nikalna chahen gay , unhen wahin wapis loata diya jaye ga , aur unn say kaha jaye ga kay :  aag kay jiss azab ko tum jhutlaya kertay thay uss ka maza chakho .
aur uss baray azab say pehlay bhi hum unhen kam darjay kay azab ka maza bhi zaroor chakhayen gay ,   shayad yeh baaz aajayen .
aur uss say bara zalim kon hoga jiss ko apney perwerdigar ki aayaton kay zariye naseehat ki gaee , to uss ney unn say mun morr liya . hum yaqeenan aesay mujrimon say badla ley ker rahen gay .

aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney musa ko kitab di thi , lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum uss kay milney kay baaray mein kissi shak mein naa raho ,   aur hum ney uss kitab ko bano Israel kay liye hidayat banaya tha ,
aur hum ney unn mein say kuch logon  ko , jab unhon ney sabar kiya , aesay peshwa bana diya jo humaray hukum say logon  ki rehnumai kertay thay , aur woh humari aayaton per yaqeen rakhtay thay .
yaqeenan tumhara perwerdigar hi qayamat kay din unn kay darmiyan unn baaton ka faisla keray ga jinn mein woh ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay .

aur kiya unn ( kafiron ) ko iss baat say koi hidayat nahi mili kay inn say pehlay kitni qoamon ko hum halak ker-chukay hain jinn kay gharon mein yeh khud chaltay phirtay hain-?   yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain . to kiya yeh log suntay nahi hain-?

aur kiya enhon ney nahi dekha kay hum paani ko kheench ker khushk zameen ki taraf ley jatay hain , phir uss say woh kheti nikaltay hain jiss say unn kay chopaye bhi khatay hain , aur woh khud bhi . to kiya enhen kuch sujhai nahi deta-?
aur woh yeh kehtay hain kay :  agar tum sachay ho to yeh faisla kab hoga-?
keh do kay :  jiss din faisla hoga , uss din kafiron ko unn ka emaan lana kuch faeeda nahi dey ga , aur naa unhen koi mohlat di jaye gi .
lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn logon  ki perwa naa kero , aur intizar kero . yeh bhi intizar ker rahey hain .
